use testdb
GO
create master key encryption by password = 'WelcomeT3stpWd@'


CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL testcredential
WITH IDENTITY='Managed Identity' 
GO


CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE testdatasource WITH
(
	LOCATION = 'abfss://cbcd360devsynpsfs@cbcd360devsynpsfs.dfs.core.windows.net',
	CREDENTIAL = testcredential
)
;


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFileFormat 
WITH (  
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET ,
        DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec'  
    );  


   
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.customer (
	[empid] nvarchar(4000),
	[empname] nvarchar(4000),
	[gender] nvarchar(4000),
	[country] nvarchar(4000),
	[remarks] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'cbc360functest/Parquet/CBC_CCD_DimCustomer_1_20220526.parquet',
	DATA_SOURCE = [testdatasource],
	FILE_FORMAT = [ParquetFileFormat]
	)
GO 


select count(1) from dbo.customer
